items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Our piano player left the band, Mr. Goodman, -- Goodson, so we hired a piano player in St. Louis, by the name of -- Morty Long. So we had -- we had Harry Edison on trumpet, George Hudson on trumpet...

ctx.x: George came and joined the band. Mr. Pitts left the band, we sent and got Walter Page on bass. To join the band. Our piano player left the band, Mr. Goodman, -- Goodson, so we hired a piano player in St. Louis, by the name of --
Morty Long. So we had -- we had Harry Edison on trumpet, George Hudson on trumpet, Snub Mosely left
